column1: # Correctness manifest for the tidy-coverage harness (tests/corpus/run.sh).
# One row per corpus input. Fields:
#   kind     table = repeated records, strict data-row count enforced
#            kv    = key/value snapshot (one observation), row count not enforced
#   rows     expected number of tidy DATA rows (table kind); '-' for kv
#   mincols  minimum number of tidy columns expected
# The engine must turn each input into tidy output meeting these, ideally via a
# GENERIC strategy (no bespoke per-tool strategy). See run.sh.
